title: Appraisal Liaison Note: The Yearly Benefit Allowance Where a Report Values the Piece Above Its Price
content:
Where a report standing on file for a piece covered by the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans with the Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services states a value above what the piece was sold at, the yearly benefit allowance the grant rests on is taken in proportion to that value rather than at the figure the coverage sets.

Where a report stands on file for the covered piece whose validity has not run out and states a value above the value the piece was sold at, the yearly benefit allowance is taken in proportion to the value that report states over the value at purchase. Where a report stands on file for the covered piece whose validity has run out and states a value above the value the piece was sold at, the yearly benefit allowance is taken in that same proportion but never above the stale-report ceiling, being 1.15 times the yearly benefit allowance the coverage sets. In any other case the yearly benefit allowance is taken as the coverage sets it.

## Which allowance the grant rests on

| Report standing on file for the piece | The value it states | The yearly benefit allowance the grant rests on |
|---|---|---|
| its validity has not run out | above the value the piece was sold at | the allowance in proportion to that value over the value at purchase |
| its validity has run out | above the value the piece was sold at | that same proportion, but never above 1.15 times the allowance the coverage sets |
| none on file, or the value stated is at or below the value at purchase | any | the allowance as the coverage sets it |

## Worked readings

A piece sold at 4000.00 USD on coverage whose yearly benefit allowance is 2500.00 USD, with a current report stating 6000.00 USD: the proportion is 6000.00 USD over 4000.00 USD, so the allowance the grant rests on is 3750.00 USD. Where that same report's validity has run out, the proportion would give 3750.00 USD but the ceiling stands at 1.15 times 2500.00 USD, being 2875.00 USD, so the allowance the grant rests on is 2875.00 USD.
